text:
jamie_csm: Heads-up: Acme Retail (acct: ACME-412) usage down ~40% over the last 14d, renewal in 35 days. CS health score dropped to 42. Need a quick save plan + enablement. Anyone able to triage?

mina_cs: On it. Can you drop the latest NPS/usage metrics and any flagged support tickets?

jamie_csm: Quick snapshot:
```
Usage tokens/day: 120k -> 72k
Active seats: 12 -> 9
Health score: 72 -> 42
Open ticket: #2341 (intermittent 5xx on /v1/chat during spikes)
Renewal: 35 days
```

leo_am: I'll take point for the customer call. Can we do a 30min micro-save tomorrow 10:30am PT? Plan: 10min config audit, 10min best-practices demo, 10min action items. @tara_ce can you prep a 1-pager and an audit checklist?

tara_ce: Yup. I'll prepare a 10-min config audit doc + one-pager on downgrade options (seat taper, route limiting, temporary feature gating). Drafts: https://redwood.internal/docs/acme-save (wip)

jamie_csm: Proposed short-term offer for the save: 25% usage credit for 2 months + a complimentary onboarding session. If they choose downgrade we need a clear re-up path: target metrics (usage >= 85% baseline) and a 30/60/90 day plan.

ops_bot: Recommended playbook: quick-audit -> targeted enablement -> short-term credit -> 30-day checkpoint. See /playbooks/churn-prevention :white_check_mark:

mina_cs: Agree. I'll own feedback capture and CSAT post-call. Suggest sending a 3-question survey: 1) primary blocker, 2) one feature to help immediately, 3) willingness to re-up if X fixed. I'll attach survey link after call.

jamie_csm: Task list:
- mina_cs: feedback + survey capture
- leo_am: run customer call (owner)
- tara_ce: enablement materials + downgrade one-pager
- jamie_csm: finance approval for credits + schedule invite
- eng-liaison: triage ticket #2341 if still open
Please update this thread when you take an action.

leo_am: If #2341 persists, @eng-liaison can you triage logs and ETA? Need fix before the call if it's causing errors.

eng-liaison: Ack. I've pinged eng-runtime and infra; initial triage within 4h. Please include any repro steps or recent traces.

tara_ce: Draft downgrade offer email (short):
```
Subject: Options to reduce costs while keeping core workflows
Hi <Name>,
We can temporarily reduce seats from 12 -> 9 or limit concurrency on heavy routes for 60 days. We'll include a 25% credit for two months and a scheduled re-evaluation on day 30 with clear metrics to restore full capacity.
Best, Tara
```

jamie_csm: Perfect. I'll send the calendar invite and finance will confirm credits. Aim: micro-save call tomorrow, capture feedback, and land follow-up action items within 72h. I'll update thread after call. :rocket:

leo_am: Ack. See you on the call.
